scientific_change: Common deployment leg Kd10 -> 8 in both engines; retain original Kp500 and frozen actor, with zero additional PPO updates.
hypothesis: One opposite damping perturbation tests whether a larger explicit-PD discretization margin improves actual contact continuity without losing source tracking or stopping.
motivation: Kd12 retains six moving-drift right-wheel gaps and does not reduce source-window right-link vibration. Increasing damping again lacks an observed favorable trend. This is one opposite-direction diagnostic, not an open-ended gain sweep.

controller_change.linear_diagnostic: Read-only mass-matrix analysis of all1153 recorded states in trial004 and008 places the local free unsaturated semiimplicit-PD stability ratio maximum near1.241 atKd8, versus1.509 atKd10 and1.778 atKd12, all below2. The most negative discrete pole moves from about-0.445 atKd10 to-0.105 atKd8. Both engines actually recompute explicit motor PD every5ms; MuJoCo implicitfast does not implicitly integrate the external control law.
controller_change.linear_exclusions: Ground contact, actor feedback, torque clipping, joint limits and finite-amplitude dynamics are excluded. Kd12 was not found unstable by this bound. Observed roughly6Hz unloading is not evidence of the fastest mode causing it. No global stability or transfer guarantee.
controller_change.risk: Physical damping falls20%, including low-mode damping; bounce, overshoot, path tracking or stopping may worsen. The outcome is unknown.

policy.selection: One fixed actor and one damping value; no trial005/006 weights, no Kp400 combination, no checkpoint or gain selection after rollout.
policy.export_identity: All12 actor/normalizer tensor bytes must exactly match the original checkpoint and baseline export. The actual exported container must be byte-identical between engines. Baseline versus regenerated container equality is not assumed: any difference requires independently pinned inference-code, tensor and all-recorded-observation output equivalence, with raw files preserved.

activation_prerequisites: Failed trial008 full four-panel evidence, semantic audit and original private byte-identity guard failure retained; public GitHub branch verified.
Unchanged gain/damping helpers and original strict publication tests pass; original checkpoint, manifest, asset, motion and profile pins verify.
Actual live readback confirms Kp500/Kd8 before policy use, with original training500/10 separately recorded.
Fresh idle target GPU/UUID guard and unmasked native device audit; no changes to other users' jobs.
Private gap/RMS/source-window comparison predeclared before this trial's physics.

evaluation.conditions: Nominal motors, original reference framezero and velocity; no added lateral velocity, hidden reset or root write.
evaluation.recording: Complete first episode at actual200Hz, with unchanged50Hz policy observations/actions.
evaluation.acceptance: At least0.20s uninterrupted speed>=0.4m/s, positive forward component, abs(sideslip)>=8deg, both actual bearing ground contacts and measured mean lateral patch slip>=0.04m/s; all original tracking, support, nonwheel-impact, full-duration and stable-exit gates must also pass.
evaluation.diagnostic_comparison: Compare004 and008 genuine moving/source right-wheel unloading, per-wheel LINK-origin vertical RMS, exact archivedPD torque and source-window sign/overlap at original times. Diagnostic improvements alone do not count as acceptance; source fidelity is separate from original assessor gates.
evaluation.format: Captured car -> TRON1 kinematic reference -> Isaac frozen policy -> MuJoCo same frozen policy; preserve full four-panel evidence on failure.
evaluation.interpretation: One nominal zero-shot controller test, not training atKd8, hardware readiness or statistical robustness. If it fails, do not continue an unbounded scalar gain search.

resources.mode: One owned application at a time on authorized remote compute, without CUDA masking/remapping.
